description: Search the Houzz directory for home services professionals by category and city, such as general contractors in Denver, CO. Returns one row per professional with name, phone, address, rating, review count, typical job cost, Houzz profile link, and any website or social links the professional listed.

categories.description: Houzz professional categories, such as general contractor, plumber, roofer, interior designer, kitchen remodelers, or a Houzz category slug such as general-contractor. One search per category per place. Houzz has 64 categories; a name Houzz does not know returns a free summary row.

dedupe.description: yes (default) returns each professional once per run, so a professional found by two searches, or shown again as a sponsored card on a later page, is charged once. no returns it again each time, charged each time.

include_sponsored.description: yes (default) returns the paid placements Houzz mixes into the results, labeled sponsored and without a rank. no returns organic results only.

locations.description: US or Canadian cities as City, ST, for example Denver, CO or Toronto, ON. Put each place on its own line. A place Houzz does not recognize, or resolves to a different city, returns a free summary row.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_results_per_search.description: Professional rows to return for each category and place, or each URL, counting sponsored cards when they are included. Houzz lists 15 organic professionals a page. Default 15, maximum 1500.

start_urls.description: Optional. Houzz directory pages, for example https://www.houzz.com/professionals/general-contractor/c/Denver--CO. Profile pages are not read.

name: find_houzz_professionals
title: Find Houzz professionals
